name: README Template Generator
description: Generate a professional README.md for your project — title, badges, features, installation, usage and license sections with your details filled in.
body:
Generated README.md

Your README will appear here.
howto: Enter your project name, a one-line description and your GitHub username.
Choose a license and the sections you want.
Review the markdown preview — badge URLs are built from your GitHub details.
Copy it or download as README.md and drop it in your repo root.
features: Professional structure: badges, features, install, usage, contributing, license
Badge row built from your GitHub username and repo name
License badge and section matched to your selection

faq.a: Yes — they use shields.io URLs constructed from your GitHub username and repo name, so they render live once your repo exists.

faq.q: Can I use this for a private project?
faq.a: Yes. Just leave the GitHub username empty to skip the badge row, or keep it — badges on private repos simply show the generic values.

faq.q: Will the README match my project exactly?
faq.a: It is a solid starting template. Customize the sections and wording to fit your project before committing.
No. It is generated entirely in your browser.
